theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted_implies_registers
theorems.claim: An accepted layout declares a register for every node.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted_implies_distinct
theorems.claim: An accepted layout never aliases a register.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted_implies_coverage
theorems.claim: An accepted layout's last layer range ends exactly at the instruction count.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.constant_predicate_iff
theorems.claim: The per-node constant match predicate holds exactly when the node is that constant and declares that register.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.slot_predicate_iff
theorems.claim: The per-node slot match predicate holds exactly when the node is that input and declares that register.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.constant_entry_refused
theorems.claim: A constant table entry that names no node is refused.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.slot_entry_refused
theorems.claim: A slot table entry that names no interface input of that slot is refused.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.merge_represents_each_arm
theorems.claim: a per-position merge never loses either arm's payload

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.distinct_owners_are_not_merged
theorems.claim: two different payloads at the same position are recorded as conflicting rather than merged

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.one_armed_join_is_refuted
theorems.claim: the seeded join that keeps only the first arm is refuted wherever the arms differ

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.same_count_different_identity_is_conflicting
theorems.claim: equal counts with different identities are conflicting, so a count-only join is insufficient

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.nested_payload_is_not_merged_with_its_unwrapping
theorems.claim: a wrapped payload is not merged with its unwrapping even though both are eligible

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.nested_resource_is_not_merged
theorems.claim: a wrapped must-use resource is never merged with a plain payload

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.unequal_arms_cannot_be_joined
theorems.claim: arms of different lengths cannot be joined and the length premise is not optional

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.joined_word_admission_agrees
theorems.claim: two stacks whose positions agree on eligibility are acquired by one word in both arms or in neither

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.some_or_none_eq_some
theorems.claim: an `if`-guarded acquired step equals its guard and its acquired table

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.none_or_some_eq_some
theorems.claim: a refused-or-acquired step equals the negation of its guard and its acquired table

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.some_or_some_eq_some
theorems.claim: two acquired branches under one guard disjoin their guards and acquired tables

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.empty_table_satisfies_the_invariants
theorems.claim: the empty bounded table satisfies the capacity and slot invariants

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.step_preserves_invariants
theorems.claim: every acquired step preserves the capacity and slot invariants

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.reachable_prefixes_satisfy_the_invariants
theorems.claim: every reachable prefix of any action list satisfies the invariants

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.abnormal_failure_survives_a_second_failure
theorems.claim: a recorded abnormal failure is not replaced by a later failure code

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.abnormal_failure_survives_a_later_success
theorems.claim: a recorded abnormal failure survives a later successful completion

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.abnormal_failure_survives_refused_and_acquired_actions
theorems.claim: a recorded abnormal failure survives refused and acquired actions

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.first_failure_code_is_kept_as_the_sticky_one
theorems.claim: two failures keep the first recorded code rather than the newest

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.baseline_admission_is_refused
theorems.claim: a full bounded table refuses the other id's admission

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.finishing_a_slot_releases_the_capacity
theorems.claim: finishing a live record releases its acquired slot

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.releasing_a_slot_enables_another_id
theorems.claim: after a release the other id's admission is enabled

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.different_ids_are_not_independent
theorems.claim: the unsound different-ids-are-independent rule: two actions on distinct ids do not commute

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.stale_generation_callback_changes_nothing
theorems.claim: a stale-generation callback leaves the table untouched

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.late_delivery_after_retirement_is_refused
theorems.claim: delivery after retirement is refused rather than appended

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.double_delivery_is_refused
theorems.claim: a second delivery of the same generation is refused

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.settlement_requires_a_delivery
theorems.claim: settlement before delivery is refused

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.settlement_after_delivery_is_taken
theorems.claim: settlement after delivery appends the ordered pair

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.finish_keeps_its_delivery_record
theorems.claim: finishing a delivered record keeps its delivery record

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.cancellation_keeps_the_pin
theorems.claim: cancellation keeps the pin held for a live record

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.lossy_observation_hides_the_failure_difference
theorems.claim: two histories with the same lossy observation differ in the documented one

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.ordered_delivery_prefixes_are_distinguished
theorems.claim: the same two delivery records in the other order are a different documented observation

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.cancel_orders_agree_on_distinct_ids
theorems.claim: cancelling the two ids in either order reaches the same documented observation at the declared bound

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.finish_orders_agree_on_distinct_ids
theorems.claim: finishing the two ids in either order reaches the same documented observation at the declared bound

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.delivery_orders_disagree_on_distinct_ids
theorems.claim: the documented observation keeps one ordered delivery record, so the two delivery orders differ

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.delivery_orders_agree_under_the_lossy_observation
theorems.claim: the same two delivery orders agree under the lossy projection, which would hide the retained dependence

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.admission_depends_on_which_id_holds_the_shared_slot
theorems.claim: with one shared unit, admitting either id succeeds and reaches a different documented observation

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.composed_admissions_agree_while_the_prefixes_differ
theorems.claim: both composed admission orders end refused, so an equality read from the composition hides the prefix dependence

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.stale_callback_is_observation_free
theorems.claim: a stale callback passes the table through unchanged at the declared bound

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.TaskInterleaving.failure_orders_disagree_on_distinct_ids
theorems.claim: the sticky first failure is shared, so the two failing-completion orders reach different observations

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Mutations.wrong_op_is_caught
theorems.claim: A seeded wrong-operation face refutes the addition face that the reference pair keeps in agreement.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Mutations.wrong_operand_is_caught
theorems.claim: A seeded wrong-operand face (one node reached twice) refutes the reference addition face.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Mutations.wrong_constant_is_caught
theorems.claim: A seeded wrong-constant face refutes the reference addition face.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Mutations.wrong_output_order_is_caught
theorems.claim: Reversing the declared ordered outputs changes the ordered results, and the reference over the declared order catches it.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Mutations.shifted_encoding_is_caught
theorems.claim: A shifted witness encoder round-trips at the slot it recorded while the graph reads another slot, so the verdict flips against the reference replay of the candidate's own bits.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Mutations.output_blind_verdict_is_caught
theorems.claim: A verdict that inspects only the first ordered result reports agreement on a pair whose second ordered result differs, and the reference comparison reports the refutation.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Mutations.all_declared_mutations_are_caught
theorems.claim: No declared faulty graph, output-order, encoder or verdict variant escapes the retained reference expectations.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.evalBatch_is_the_ordered_map
theorems.claim: the bounded batch is exactly the ordered map of independent row runs

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.evalBatch_append
theorems.claim: appending batches appends results, so partial progress is the ordered map over the prefix

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.a_refused_row_does_not_affect_later_rows
theorems.claim: a refused row stands at its own position and cannot change any other row's result

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.a_rows_run_starts_from_an_empty_stack
theorems.claim: each row's run starts from an empty stack, so rows cannot supply or consume each other's operands

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.add_row_result_is_the_wrapping_sum
theorems.claim: a validated addition row's reference result is the wrapping sum of its two operands

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.sub_row_result_is_the_wrapping_difference
theorems.claim: a validated subtraction row's reference result is the wrapping difference of its two operands

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.mul_row_result_is_the_wrapping_product
theorems.claim: a validated multiplication row's reference result is the wrapping product of its two operands

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.out_of_range_row_is_refused
theorems.claim: an out-of-range literal row is refused at its own position rather than silently coerced

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.batch_row_executes_as_its_reference_run
theorems.claim: each batch row's lowered fragment executes exactly as that row's reference run, reusing the sequence-lifting theorem
